what_happened: Reproduced that the FULL-regen path (generate-todo.sh -> generate-task-order.sh --print, the dominant TODO.md regeneration mechanism invoked by state-write.sh --regen-todo and most other callers) drops the Goal line unconditionally on every run, regardless of active_goal or a pre-existing hand-written TODO.md Goal line -- not only in the no-prior-line case the dispatch described. Confirmed by scratch repro: a TODO.md with an existing hand-written Goal line, regenerated via generate-todo.sh, loses the line entirely, because --print mode's GOAL_TEXT resolution is gated to MODE=="update" only and never calls read_existing_goal() or reads active_goal. Outcome #1's precedence chain must be applied to BOTH --print and --update-todo code paths, not just --update-todo, or the fix will not actually fix the review.md Section 6.7.3 call site that motivated this task (it uses --regen-todo, which goes through the --print path).

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification honesty check caught a per-path suite claim for Phase 3 that was wrong in aggregate: suite_selection_select collapses a mixed path set to __FULL_SWEEP__ when any path is unmapped, so the per-path suite list (correct for state-schema.json alone) was a fabricated claim for the set. Corrected to the sentinel's source-store gate-subset form before the plan was returned.

Premise re-validation found the defect reproducible live in this repository, not only in the research phase's scratch tree: specs/state.json carries a non-empty active_goal while specs/TODO.md's Task Order section carries no Goal line. This gave Phase 4 a real end-to-end acceptance check requiring no synthetic fixture.

class: test coverage closes a verified gap
what_happened: Phase 2 red-then-green evidence for Outcome #4: against the unmodified script, 5 new cases produced exactly 4 failures (5a, 5b, 5d-print-half, 5e-print-half; Results: 22 passed, 4 failed), precisely matching the plan's predicted red set. After adding resolve_goal_text() and removing the MODE==update gate, Results: 26 passed, 0 failed.

deploy-headless.sh's internal fast-gate verification returned RESULT=landed_verify_red with 5/41 checks failing: gate3/gate4/gate10 each hit the deploy wrapper's internal 60s per-gate timeout under this /orchestrate batch's concurrent load, and TODO.md was out of sync with state.json (the active_goal gap this task exists to fix, not yet closed at that point). Standalone re-runs of check-extension-docs.sh (35s), check-task-references.sh (37s), and validate-state.sh --deep (after generate-todo.sh regenerated TODO.md, 100s) all PASS cleanly -- confirming the timeouts were transient load artifacts, not real regressions.

deploy-headless.sh's fast-gate verification also reported 2 pre-existing, sibling-owned failures unrelated to this task: eager-load context-budget total (71712B > 70400B baseline) and skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (25510B > 25000B ceiling). git log -- agent-system/extensions/core/skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md shows the file was last touched by tasks 450 and 609, neither of which is task 490; the file is not in task 490's declared file_scope. Recorded as a Reasoned Exclusion on Phase 4 rather than absorbed into this task's scope.
